thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — Lomax (customer: lomax-inc) VPC dedicated pool 'lomax-prod-gpu' reporting elevated error-rate and tail latency. 30% increase in 500s, multiple OOMs in quantized variant. Marking Sev2, paging oncall. https://logs.redwood.example/lomax/2113456789 :eyes:
raj: Oncall (SRE) taking this. quick summary? is customer traffic impacted or just background probes?
emma: Observed failing inference calls from tenant traffic, not just probes. Errors are model runtime OOM and a fallback loop that retries and times out.
mike: Eng-runtime: looks like the quantized 4-bit variant we rolled for lomax yesterday is thrashing its KV cache under long-history sessions. KV growth + mem fragmentation -> OOM.
tara: Customer success: lomax is seeing user-facing failures in their internal product flow. They already opened a support ticket and asked for immediate mitigation. Customer is enterprise, SLAs in play.
raj: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Pin lomax to safe model variant (non-quantized or conservative quantization) 2) Temporarily route lomax traffic to the fallback dedicated pool (lomax-fallback) 3) Rolling restart of offending pods. Need owner for steps 1 and 2.
mike: I can do the pin + routing. will need an override because customer has explicit tenant-pin config set to auto.
lina: Security/controls: any config change to routing in VPC needs audit note. I'll create an audit event and be on the call.
raj: Good — mike own it, emma will handle restarts and monitoring, tara will coordinate customer comms, lina will handle audit, julie (solutions) on standby for model gating questions.
mike: Starting manual pin now. Patch to tenant routing config:```yaml
tenant: lomax-inc
model_pin: lomax-model-v2.3-safe
routing_override: lomax-fallback
force_pin: true  # temporary emergency override
```
mike: Applying via control plane: `redwood ctl tenant apply --tenant lomax-inc --file lomax-pin-urgent.yaml`
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: change to tenant lomax-inc by mike. CI checks passed. Starting apply.
emma: K8s: restarting pods serving lomax in lomax-prod-gpu to clear KV cache. `kubectl -n inference rollout restart ds/lomax-gpu-ds`
emma: Monitoring logs now. watch command: `kubectl -n inference logs -l tenant=lomax-inc -f`
raj: Keep latency windows and error-rate dashboards open, baseline before/after: last 15m 5xx = 32% 99th latency = 3.8s.
mike: Pin applied, routing_override set. control plane returned success. audit id: AUD-20260315-021.
deploy-bot: Apply succeeded: change-id=chg_7b9f.
emma: Restarts done, new pods in Running. Initial health checks passing. 5xx rate dropped to ~8% within 4 minutes. 99p latency down to 1.1s.
tara: I updated Lomax support ticket: short-lived routing override and model pin applied; we're monitoring and will follow up in 30m. Customer asked if this will cause config drift for their infra. I told them we will reverse the override after stable period and share timeline.
julie: Quick note on model quality — safe variant has slightly different tokenization behavior. Recommend running the lomax internal smoke prompts to validate responses before finalizing. I can run a quick sample suite.
mike: Agree. launching quick eval set now against lomax-model-v2.3-safe.
mike: Eval results: 24/25 smoke prompts OK, one minor formatting diff (not blocking).
lina: Created audit log entry and policy exception for emergency override. Exception will auto-expire after 6 hours unless extended.
raj: Nice work. Next: run 30m staging window, if stable then schedule controlled canary revert to quantify perf/quality delta and then propose final plan to customer (either keep safe pin or roll a fixed quantized build with KV limits).
emma: Setting monitoring alert to watch for regression. Added auto-escalation to pager if 5xx > 10% for 5m.
mike: I'll also push a runtime patch to cap KV growth for the quantized variant as a mitigation (non-disruptive). PR opened: #2894.
tara: Customer responded: appreciates fast action, wants postmortem and timeline for when normal routing restored.
julie: I'll coordinate a short internal QA run Wednesday morning to see if we can re-introduce quantized with the KV cap and longer-lived pods.
raj: Handing to next oncall in 20m. current status: mitigation applied, customer informed, metrics stable. If anyone needs follow-up, please file a postmortem tag `lomax-vpc-20260315` and add notes. :thumbsup:
emma: Oncall handoff to night shift (raj -> priya). priya alerted.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — status: mitigated. Tags: lomax, vpc, tenant-pin, model-pin, safemode.
raj: Closing active pager for now. Will keep the thread for postmortem notes. Thanks all. :pray:
